server.name: finbook-mcp
server.description: Executable MCP manifest for the Finbook tool surface

tools.name: finbook.get_contract
tools.title: Finbook Get Contract
tools.description: Return the current Finbook MCP contract so agents can discover the supported tool surface, optionally including the semantic manifest and the public executable manifest.

includeSemanticManifest.description: When true, include the semantic Finbook MCP manifest in the response. Defaults to true for HTTP discovery.

includeExecutableManifest.description: When true, include the public executable Finbook MCP manifest in the response. Defaults to true for HTTP discovery.

tools.name: finbook.describe_semantic_structure
tools.title: Finbook Describe Semantic Structure
tools.description: Describe the semantic structure of the Finbook database: account model, transactional tables, reference data, computed views, and preferred mutation patterns.

tools.name: finbook.get_schema
tools.title: Finbook Get Schema
tools.description: Return Finbook schema metadata for all supported tables and computed fields.

tools.name: finbook.get_committed_state
tools.title: Finbook Get Committed State
tools.description: Return the full committed Finbook state snapshot as a fallback read tool for broad reasoning.

tools.name: finbook.get_working_state
tools.title: Finbook Get Working State
tools.description: Return the full working Finbook state snapshot, including pending server-journal changes, as a fallback read tool for broad reasoning.

tools.name: finbook.validate_working_state
tools.title: Finbook Validate Working State
tools.description: Validate the current Finbook working state and return deterministic structural errors and warnings without requiring file access.

tools.name: finbook.list_journal_entries
tools.title: Finbook List Journal Entries
tools.description: Return the effective uncommitted journal entries that contribute to the current working state since the last commit. Discarded entries are filtered out.

tools.name: finbook.get_journal_summary
tools.title: Finbook Get Journal Summary
tools.description: Return a user-oriented semantic summary of the effective uncommitted journal entries that contribute to the current working state since the last commit. The summary is computed only from cleaned active entries and is shaped for cards or brief UI summaries.

tools.name: finbook.list_accounts
tools.title: Finbook List Accounts
tools.description: List available Finbook accounts in the connected data repo.

tools.name: finbook.get_repo_config
tools.title: Finbook Get Repo Config
tools.description: Return repo-level Finbook configuration and append-only reference tables.

tools.name: finbook.get_account_profile
tools.title: Finbook Get Account Profile
tools.description: Return append-only account profile/reference data for one Finbook account.

tools.name: finbook.list_table_rows
tools.title: Finbook List Table Rows
tools.description: Return computed rows for a Finbook table, optionally filtered by financial year.

tools.name: finbook.get_computed_view
tools.title: Finbook Get Computed View
tools.description: Return one named computed Finbook view for an account. Preferred over export_account for agent and application access to computed results.

asOn.description: Optional as-on date in YYYY-MM-DD format for holdings.

tools.name: finbook.run_report
tools.title: Finbook Run Report
tools.description: Run a shared Finbook computed report for an account. Compatibility alias for finbook.get_computed_view.

asOn.description: Optional as-on date in YYYY-MM-DD format for holdings.

tools.name: finbook.append_repo_config_entry
tools.title: Finbook Append Repo Config Entry
tools.description: Append one repo-config reference entry. This is the preferred append-only tool for repo-level Finbook master data.

key.description: Unique append-only key within the category.

value.description: Optional value payload for the appended entry.

tools.name: finbook.append_account_profile_entry
tools.title: Finbook Append Account Profile Entry
tools.description: Append one account-profile reference entry. This is the preferred append-only tool for account master data.

key.description: Unique append-only key within the category.

value.description: Optional value payload for the appended entry.

tools.name: finbook.upsert_row
tools.title: Finbook Upsert Row
tools.description: Create or update one Finbook row in a table as a generic fallback when no more semantic write tool applies.

row.description: Row payload to create or merge.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.delete_row
tools.title: Finbook Delete Row
tools.description: Delete one Finbook row from a table by index or row reference as a generic correction tool.

row.description: Optional row reference when deleting by dedup keys.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to delete.

tools.name: finbook.record_stock_purchase
tools.title: Finbook Record Stock Purchase
tools.description: Record a stock purchase or transfer-in entry in Finbook. Preferred over the generic row tool for stock-purchase writes.

entry.description: Stock purchase entry payload for StockPurchasesOrTransferIns.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.record_stock_sale
tools.title: Finbook Record Stock Sale
tools.description: Record a stock sale or transfer-out entry in Finbook. Preferred over the generic row tool for stock-sale writes.

entry.description: Stock sale entry payload for StockSalesOrTransferOuts.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.record_income
tools.title: Finbook Record Income
tools.description: Record a non-stock income entry using one of the known Finbook income types: salary, foreign, property, or other. Preferred over the generic row tool for income writes.

entry.description: Income entry payload for the selected income type table.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.record_capital_gain_outside_stock_transactions
tools.title: Finbook Record Capital Gain Outside Stock Transactions
tools.description: Record a manual or consolidated capital gain entry that cannot be derived from recorded stock purchase and sale transactions. Preferred over the generic row tool for manual capital gains.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.record_advance_tax_paid
tools.title: Finbook Record Advance Tax Paid
tools.description: Record an advance-tax payment entry in Finbook. Preferred over the generic row tool for advance-tax writes.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.
